baseline_source: round-1 winner (v4-m4-enforcement) promoted to hat/SKILL.md (278 lines)
rationale: v2-m3-integration wins on the highest integration score (+0.19 vs baseline) via three new contract surfaces: (1) a 5-step Constitution-conflict fallback ordering that closes the hat-overrides-constitution loophole, (2) an explicit Handoff Payload JSON schema (hat_persona / yielded_to / override_source / skip_step_4b / exemption_reason) so host skills like exp-sum/unblock-recipes/brainstorming/systematic-debugging can align state with hat without ambiguity, and (3) an ASCII Flow Diagram that visualizes the Step 1 -> yield vs constitution-fallback vs hat-own -> Step 5 path. v2 also adds 2 sub_skill rows (brainstorming/systematic-debugging) to the meta-skill precedence table with handoff-payload columns, slightly tightening enforcement (+0.01) because the constitution fallback now has explicit ordering rather than a one-line shrug. Cost is volume (+58 lines, biggest variant), dragging volume_efficiency to 0.72. v1-m2-completeness is a close second (0.878) by adding 6 high-value Q&A entries (covers explicit-user-hat / disable-notification / sub-skill-override-still-triggers-self-check / RF-7-third-switch / 钻-on-subjective / <5字-scope) plus a reuse change-location table; strong on actionability (+0.02) and triggerability (+0.01) but adds bulk (+21 lines). v3-m5-consolidation wins volume_efficiency (+0.09) by merging the 严格度排序 table into the 8-hats table and consolidating Output Contract as canonical reference point (-15 lines vs baseline) without losing any RF/Q/rationalization — but adds zero new gates or integration so net gain is only +0.003. Critical finding: none of the three variants clears the +0.05 improvement threshold. The baseline is already strong (round-1 winner with 9 RFs + 5-question Self-Check + honeypot rejection); marginal improvements on integration (v2) or completeness (v1) or volume (v3) each gain ~0.005-0.02 but the baseline contract is mature enough that further gains require either a new mechanism class (not seen) or absorbing all three variants' strengths simultaneously. Recommendation: status no_improvement — do not promote any variant as-is. Consider a round-3 hybrid that takes v2's handoff payload + constitution fallback + v1's Q&A + v3's consolidation pattern; that combined delta could plausibly clear +0.05.
